QuestInfo.name: You Surpass Me
QuestInfo.0: You have returned to the Underground Base with #p2151004#. Talk to #p2151004# to see if he's fully recovered.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2151004# says he's made a full recovery, but suspects you've fully surpassed him. He passes down his strongest skill--one so mighty, even he's never been able to master it.

Become a Resistance member worthy of his hopes.
Drive the Black Wings out of town and find peace!
